title: Valley of the Kings
summary: The Valley of the Kings is a desert valley on the west bank of the Nile opposite ancient Thebes (modern Luxor), where rulers of Egypt's 18th, 19th and 20th dynasties were buried between about 1550 and 1069 BCE. Thutmose I is the first ruler confirmed buried there; it has over sixty tombs, including Tutankhamun's. UNESCO lists it within Ancient Thebes with its Necropolis (1979).

uncertainty.note: The Egyptian Ministry gives the New Kingdom as c. 1550-1069 BC, during which the rulers were buried here; UNESCO gives the tombs as 1500-1000 BCE. Burial in the valley began with Thutmose I (c. 1504-1492 BC).
